dict.string: myco listens only while you have the microphone, a voice call or a recording on: to turn what you say into a message, to talk with your agents, or to record a meeting. 只在你打开麦克风、语音聊天或录音时听：把你说的话变成消息，和 agent 们语音聊天，或者录会议。

An app in myco (会议记录) records what your Mac plays, such as a Zoom or Tencent Meeting call, only while you record. The recording stays on this Mac. myco 里的应用（会议记录）只在你录音时录下 Mac 放出的声音，比如 Zoom、腾讯会议里别人说的话；录音只存在这台 Mac 上。
myco turns what you say into text, for your message box or a voice call with your agents, in the language you chose for the app. 把你说的话转成文字，用在输入框或和 agent 们的语音聊天里，用你在 App 里选的语言。
